player_prompt.intro:
Yaa kɛndɛ Sokoban kɛlɛ. Yaa kɛndɛ ne yaa tɛ sɔgɔmɛ kɛlɛ pɔɔrɛ dɛsɛ.
        Yaa bɛ kɛlɛ pɔɔrɛ dɛsɛ la, yaa kɛndɛ pɔɔrɛ dɛsɛ nɛɛ.
        Yaa tɛ pɔɔrɛ dɛsɛ kɛlɛ wɔɔgɔ la, yaa tɛ pɔɔrɛ dɛsɛ kɛlɛ.
        Kɛlɛ pɔɔrɛ dɛsɛ la, yaa wɛɛ:
        - Kɛndɛ (yaa) wɛɛ 'P' 
        - Wɔɔgɔ wɛɛ '#' 
        - Pɔɔrɛ dɛsɛ wɛɛ 'X' 
        - Kɔɔrɔ wɛɛ 'O'
        - Pɔɔrɛ dɛsɛ kɔɔrɔ wɛɛ '√'
        Yaa kɛndɛ tɛ [w] kɛɛ kɔɔrɔ, [a] kɛɛ bɛɛrɛ, [s] kɛɛ pɔɔrɛ, [d] kɛɛ kɔɔrɔ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kɔndɛ sɔgɔ wɛlɛ ka tɛ kɛlɛ fɔrmɛ nɛ. Kɔndɛ [up], [down], [left], [right] wɛlɛ [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.not_valid_action: B sẽn da kõ sorã pa tʋʋm-sõng ye.
invalid_move.wall_collision: Y pa tõe n kẽed lalg pʋgẽ ye!
invalid_move.invalid_position: Zĩ-kãng ka tõe n kẽng zĩig ning ye.
